title: Preliminary
summary: PRELIM'INARY, adjective [Latin proe, before, and limen, threshhold or limit.] Introductory; previous; proemial; that precedes the main discourse or business; as preliminary observations to a discourse

inlines.v: PRELIM'INARY, adjective [Latin proe, before, and limen, threshhold or limit.] Introductory; previous; proemial; that precedes the main discourse or business; as preliminary observations to a discourse or book; preliminary articles to a treaty; preliminary measures. PRELIM'INARY, noun That which precedes the main discourse, work, design or business; something previous or preparatory; as the preliminaries to a negotiation or treaty; the preliminaries to a combat. The parties met to settle the preliminaries.
